page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.small is a general-purpose, entry-level virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features a single shared vCPU mapped to one physical core of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supporting instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX-512 VNNI), AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.mn4.small operates in the lower performance tiers. In stress-ng testing, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance scored 1072.5, placing the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block cached performance at 77.27 GB/sec, while uncached large block read and write speeds are 8.56 GB/sec and 7.08 GB/sec, both falling in the bottom 10%. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 791.0 and a multi-core score of 890.0.

Due to the shared CPU allocation and entry-level hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-efficient option for low-intensity workloads where resource density is prioritized over raw performance. Tradeoffs include limited processing power, low memory bandwidth, and the lack of dedicated local storage. The instance is best suited for lightweight, non-critical tasks such as basic static web serving, minor database operations, or running small-scale background scripts.
